# Iris

**Wipe › Iris** · v1.0.0 · 24 frames at 30 fps (10–60)

A circle opens from a point and grows until the new scene fills the frame.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/iris@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Reveals
- Retro and cartoon looks
- Focusing on a subject

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import iris from './transitions/03-wipe/iris/iris';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(iris, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 24 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | Centre x (0..1). |
| `y` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | Centre y (0..1). |
| `softness` | number | `0` | 0–200 | Edge softness in pixels. |
